sources: recreation.gov campsite search API for asset 10122661 (24 sites)
https://www.fs.usda.gov/sites/nfs/files/publication/2026%20Campground%20Table%20WhiteRiverNF_All%20Campgrounds_0.pdf (2026 Campground and Day Use Area Operating Dates)

values.note: $25 a night on recreation.gov (2026 and 2027 peak seasons); the Forest Service page and 2026 table say $27. One RV with tow vehicle per site; an extra vehicle pays a nightly fee collected at the campground.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10122661/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-20..10-01 and 2027-05-20..10-01: PeakStandardNonelectric 25) + notice 'One RV with tow vehicle per single site ... Extra vehicle will be charged a per night fee'; FS page 'Single Site: $27 per night' and 2026 table '$27', read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 10122661 (all 24 sites STANDARD/TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC) + notice 'No drinking water available at this campground'; FS page 'Potable water is not available at this site', read 2026-10-26

values.note: All sites back-in. recreation.gov calls them 'suitable for tents and smaller trailers'; its catalog gives driveway lengths of 10-20 ft at most sites (site 009 45 ft). Sites 003, 005 and 008 are tent-only.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/sites/nfs/files/publication/2026%20Campground%20Table%20WhiteRiverNF_All%20Campgrounds_0.pdf ('Blue River CG 8,400 25/25'' # of sites / max site length) + FS page ('There are 24 camping sites') + recreation.gov catalog (24 sites, all Back-in; Driveway Length 10-20, one 45), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Bear-proof trash receptacles and a food storage locker at each site.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/blue-river-campground ('vault toilets, picnic tables and a fire pit'; 'Potable water is not available at this site') + recreation.gov ('Each site has a picnic table, fire ring and bear box'; 'Bear-proof trash receptacles are provided'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Estimated opening dates; they can shift with the weather.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/sites/nfs/files/publication/2026%20Campground%20Table%20WhiteRiverNF_All%20Campgrounds_0.pdf ('Blue River CG ... Season 5/20-10/2'; 'These are estimated opening dates. Opening dates can adjust based on weather'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Book at least 3 days ahead. The site must be occupied the first night; a reserved site is held until 11am the day after arrival, then released. Two catalog sites (011, 022) are not reservable.

booking.source: recreation.gov 10122661 rules (reservationCutOff 3; minWeekendStay/minHolidayWeekendStay 0 soft = no rule) + notices ('Campers must occupy the site the first night'; 'Reserved Sites will be held until check out time (ELEVEN) the day following your arrival date') + rates Peak Season 2026-05-20..10-01; FS page 'Stay limit is 14 days'; FS 2026 table 'R', read 2026-10-26

note: Dillon Ranger District, White River NF: along the Blue River on Hwy 9 between Silverthorne and Green Mountain Reservoir; run by concessionaire American Land & Leisure. Site access is difficult when the road is wet, and sites may close for flooding. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + catalog + FS page + 2026 forest table: confirmed $25 (rec.gov 2026), no electric (added no water hookup), 24 sites; added max 25 ft (FS table), back-in only, vault toilets/no potable water, season 5/20-10/2, 3-day cutoff, 14-night max, booking season 5/20-10/1. Pin 31 m from the site centroid. Not open now (season ended 10/2); no alert or closure order for it. Note: dropped '24 sites' and 'Reservable online'.

Site count: FS page and recreation.gov 24; the 2026 FS table says 25. Kept 24.
